task_specification.objective: Repair movement intent integration and explicitly implement the authored arena/spatial and upgrade-choice capabilities while making ordinary completion and representative dense profiling qualification-ready.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active movement issue is an input-to-physics integration failure: dispatch is observed but authoritative Warden position and velocity remain unchanged. Complete-run qualification is absent because prior evidence only covered diagnostic terminal/retry behavior and an idle zero-workload profile. The required arena capability also needs an explicit authored-world implementation task covering scale, external context, landmark/perimeter collision, occlusion, and ordinary-movement replay.

stop_conditions: Cover each required gap exactly once across task.gap_ids.
Assign each active issue exactly once across task.issue_ids.
Do not schedule deferred issue work or claim Tester/GameLoop Runtime closure.
Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and native Godot baselines.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different strategy from repeated transform tuning: establish an explicit context-safe movement bridge, restore spatial integrity through the authored-world contract and camera-aware composition, make choice hierarchy a concrete UI implementation, and harden bounded production stress profiling.

code: Run Godot parse/static checks for touched GDScript and verify InputMap actions, scene NodePaths, authored-world anchors, collision resources, and upgrade icon resources resolve.

Run focused checks for movement intent/release, dash debouncing, upgrade projection truth and card delta filtering, world bounds/landmark collision alignment, terminal exactly-once lifecycle, live-cap/pool bounds, and profile metric serialization.
Re-run native_godot_project and host_godot_boot preservation checks.
runtime: Tester/GameLoop Runtime recapture movement and dash with keyboard/gamepad-equivalent sequences, before/after transforms and velocity, context/release receipts, and pause/retry reset.

Replay ordinary movement from spawn through the loop, cross-route, keeper-post, mausoleum, cracked-bell, and perimeter cells; capture landmark collision, visibility, external-world framing, and no-pass-through/no-disappearance receipts from the same shipped camera.
Recapture the authored choice draft at native viewport with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states; verify one debounced authoritative selection and changed post-resume behavior.

Recapture an ordinary 420–600 second title-to-result route, three distinct successful build shapes, failure and victory branches, statistics, Credits & Notices, Retry, and title/replay without diagnostic qualification.
visual: Capture spawn, loop/cross-route, each landmark, perimeter/external-world boundary, dense-wave, upgrade draft, failure Result, victory Result, Retry, and title views.

Verify icon-led upgrade hierarchy, truthful current/new columns, distinct focus states, larger traversable composition, aligned visible/collision landmarks, stable perimeter visibility, no void/proxy-floor seams, no floating/intersecting collision props, and no camera occlusion drift.

done_when: WASD and gamepad-equivalent movement change Warden position and planar velocity in all four directions during active gameplay.
Movement intent remains authoritative through gameplay context handoff and is cleared on release, pause, retry, and title transitions.
Dash accepts one activation per physical press and records anticipation, active invulnerability, recovery, cooldown, and reset phases without contradictory velocity.
The high-angle camera remains gameplay-only and keeps the Warden, nearby threats, pickups, projectiles, and an escape lane readable.
Tester can retest before/after transforms, velocity, input source, context generation, dash generation, and pause/resume receipts.
tasks.instructions: Repair the InputContextRouter-to-Warden integration by making movement intent an explicit context-safe state or signal consumed by the CharacterBody3D physics tick instead of relying on a transient edge or polling cache. Audit process modes, context generations, release handling, and dash ownership; retain camera-relative sliding and existing authored presentation. Add focused receipts for input source, intent, velocity/position deltas, dash phases, pause/resume, and retry reset. Do not compensate with mesh transform tuning or replace preserved assets.
tasks.title: Restore movement and dash intent

done_when: Replace text-stacked upgrade and weapon choices with authored silhouettes or icons as the primary hierarchy, compact stat icons, restrained consequence copy, and aligned truthful CURRENT-to-NEW values for no more than three changed decision-relevant stats.
Never show NEW or LOCKED as a fake CURRENT value; omit unchanged, zero, unrelated, and exhaustive rows.

Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and selected states are distinct without changing card dimensions; held confirm cannot double-commit and gameplay stays paused until authoritative application.
The authored cemetery is demonstrably larger than a camera-sized combat pad, with a traversable loop and cross-route plus a coherent non-playable external world beyond the playable boundary.

Keeper-post, mausoleum, cracked-bell, and perimeter boundaries have aligned visible geometry and collision; ordinary movement replay reaches each landmark/perimeter without pass-through, disappearance, void exposure, or camera-occlusion drift.

A normal non-diagnostic run advances through five waves, elite pressure, Bellkeeper two-phase defeat, exactly one terminal commit, truthful statistics/build summary/credits-provenance, Result, Retry, and clean title/replay state.
tasks.instructions: Implement the required choice capability directly in scripts/ui/upgrade_draft.gd and scenes/ui/upgrade_draft.tscn: replace text-stacked cards with a first-class weapon or upgrade silhouette/icon hierarchy, compact stat icons, at most three concrete current-to-new deltas, concise consequence copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus styling. In the same ordinary-release family, explicitly restore authored arena spatial integrity: use the intact cemetery package as the sole visual world, ensure sufficient traversable scale and a coherent external world beyond the boundary, rebase spawn/objective/collision/navigation anchors to native streets, align keeper-post/mausoleum/cracked-bell and perimeter collision with their visible landmarks, and make camera-aware composition prevent landmark/player disappearance or occlusion during an ordinary movement replay. Then repair RunController/CompleteRunLedger so only a real seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result route qualifies; diagnostic prepare/advance/commit actions remain editor-guarded and cannot qualify it.
tasks.title: Restore authored arena and qualify ordinary release

done_when: A native 1920x1080 representative final-wave profile runs with 25–40 ordinary enemies, Bellkeeper, all three weapon families, pickups, HUD, animation, VFX, lights, and audio active.

The bounded sample records non-zero requested/resolved workload, frame-time and physics p50/p95/p99/worst metrics, subsystem/high-churn counts, coverage cells, runtime-error count, and start/end lifecycle counters.

Live caps, spawn validation, targeting/steering queries, projectiles, pickups, particles, lights, audio voices, and pooled actors remain bounded with no recurring runtime errors, NaN movement, post-terminal spawning, or freed-instance access.
Three complete retries show isolated node, callback, audio, and input counts with reset receipts tied to run/setup generations.
Tester can run editor-only prepare, advance, and reset profile actions against real production workload and inspect candidate-bound receipts.
